**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

- **§ 2(a) Licence Grant (p0022/p0024):** Contains an express *pro-Customer* carve-out — we are "not obligated to utilize the License and [are] free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system... to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink," limited only by TrueLink's IP and our § 10 confidentiality obligations. This exceeds our preferred position.
- **§ 8 Covenants of Client (p0051–p0058):** Confined to legal compliance, non-misrepresentation of underwriting decisions, access controls, content warranties and anti-spam. No field-of-use, territory, or competing-product restraint.
- **§ 7:** Restricts spamming only — not a competitive restraint.
- **"Non-Competition Agreement" (p0054):** The sole competition reference. It operates as a *limit on TrueLink's* licence to exploit our Credit Data, so it runs in our favour and is not a covenant binding us. Flagged in the rationale for separate diligence, since that instrument sits outside this agreement and was not available for review.
